title: Three Capital cities named after rivers | Three things daily
content: Three things everyday a little after 8 am in India. Amsterdam: Derived from Amstellerdam, meaning “A Dam on the Amstel River” in Dutch. The Amstel’s name is derived from Aeme stelle, old Dutch for “area abounding with water”. Minsk: The Old East Slavic name of the town was Мѣньскъ (i.e. Měnsk < Early Proto-Slavic or Late Indo-European Mēnĭskŭ), derived from a river name Měn (< Mēnŭ, with the same etymology as German Main; from Latin Moenus or Menus). title: Smith Stadium at Ramer Field - Facilities - University of Wisconsin River Falls Athletics
content: The sun sets over the David Smith Stadium Press Box during the Falcon football home opener at Ramer Field against South Dakota School of Mines and Technology Saturday September 19, 2015.Kathy M Helgeson/Staff. Football home opener at Ramer Field against South Dakota School of Mines and Technology Saturday September 19, 2015.Kathy M Helgeson/Staff. ## Smith Stadium at Ramer Field. David Smith Stadium recognizes the lead gift from the Smith Family and First National Bank of River Falls in memory of David M. Smith, who was a passionate UWRF and River Falls High School football fan. David was the third generation of the Smith family who own and operate the First National Bank of River Falls, where he served as Board Chair, President and CEO until his death in 1994. The south entrance gate is named the Francis Charles "Fran" Polsfoot Gate through gifts from former players in honor of the former UW River Falls head football coach and head track coach, who coached the Falcons from 1957 to 1961.

title: Centreville Bank Stadium Named Official Home of Rhode Island FC - Rhode Island FC
content: # Centreville Bank Stadium Named Official Home of Rhode Island FC. (April 8, 2025) – Continuing its partnership with Centreville Bank, Rhode Island FC announced today that the club’s new stadium has officially been named **Centreville Bank Stadium**. Horvat.** “In partnership with Rhode Island FC, Centreville Bank Stadium will be the center of action in Rhode Island and a driver of economic progress, creating lasting, meaningful impact for generations to come.”. “We are thrilled to see that Centreville Bank, which has a branch right here in Pawtucket, is the naming rights partner for the beautiful new stadium,” **said City of Pawtucket Mayor Donald Grebien.** “Centreville Bank is a tremendous community partner and has been a long-time supporter of the city of Pawtucket. I can’t wait to watch Rhode Island FC compete in the new Centreville Bank Stadium, and to welcome the thousands of cheering fans who will be visiting the City of Pawtucket to cheer on the team.”.
